## What it is

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Learning about science has never been so interactive! Check out playful experiments like the Whisper Dishes, parabolic dishes that bounce sound across the room, or The Tornado, where you can watch a funnel cloud form and touch the storm.
>
> Children under six can get even more involved at Kid City and have tons of chances to play and learn at the same time. Don't miss Studio X, a space for makers and innovators that lets you join the project of the day or even create your own design!
